reason: The plan satisfies every hard requirement (≤12 numbered steps, rollback, non-production rehearsal, post-cutover integrity checks via row counts/checksums, stakeholder communication, and a pre-cutover full backup) and correctly uses continuous logical replication plus a final incremental sync to make a 2 TB migration feasible within a 2-hour window, but it shows no explicit self-check against the requirements and leaves some operational nuances (extension compatibility, connection pooling/DNS TTL) unaddressed.
